snippet.title: Mechaccountant Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Mechaccountant now! https://redmser.itch.io/mechaccountant

A game made by a team of four, created for the MechJam III
Check out the jam here: https://itch.io/jam/mechjam3
If you participated, be sure to vote as well! :)

Trailer Music: Faux Tales - Stateless

Main features:
- Take direct control of a giant mecha while inside it
- Move towards nearby cities and attack the enemy mechas
- Order items, request attacks, and sign papers on your mecha's desk
- Follow company orders, sign government documents, and avoid spam mail

Minimum requirements:
~800 MB RAM

The team consists of:
9joao6
Blatoy
Nebulis
RedMser
